findings.decision: performance limitation documented; unsafe suggested unlock rejected
findings.reason: The bounded allocation and row copy hold native/resource locks so reset or native teardown cannot unmap/release the borrowed mapped slice. CPU alpha decoding and delivery run after unmap/release and outside these locks. The specification now explicitly states the copy can delay paint/resize, permits a lower MaxSnapshotBytes limit, and makes no latency guarantee. Chunked copying needs a separately tested ownership redesign and timing qualification.

findings.decision: precommit provenance honestly retained; clean committed SDK verification follows commit
findings.reason: These are explicitly precommit race-binary acceptance runs tied to source hashes, checked patch manifests and pinned preparation, not release-build claims. A fresh private SDK from the clean commit will reproduce and hash every prepared native input, match every reviewed source hash, verify every archive file and run generated/API/imaging consumers after relocation. The archive and proof live outside the repository to avoid a self-referential commit record. Public distribution qualification remains open.
Same disposition as 1f7c2908427cf878; historical precommit/race evidence is preserved rather than rewritten as clean-release evidence.

findings.decision: refuted for the fixed-size independent consumer
findings.reason: Private imageSize=256 controls storage allocation, single-sample float texture dimensions, uniform source dimensions and workgroup dispatch. The consumer exposes exposure and viewport controls, not a configurable source width. Its model regression asserts the exact source uniform and allocation sizes.

Success and both synchronous/asynchronous error paths now share a nonblocking bounded smoke-diagnostic reporter. An unread prior diagnostic retains precedence. The regression fills the channel and exercises real admission rejection and owner-held completion state without blocking or leaving the Capture button busy.

The final fixture verifies explicit domain lifetime cancellation and registration removal, observes program release and native closure, then requires native.Lock to return false outside the owner. The lock round-trip serializes with completed native teardown. A separate terminal context and process watchdog cover shutdown. It does not claim to observe private decoder/reservation destruction.

discarded_findings_independently_checked.reason: The native fixture actually admits capture and directly closes that native window in one owner-held seam, waits native closure, asserts Stats unavailable and no callback, and verifies surviving-window pixels. The prose field states the separate private-cleanup limitation; it is not the fixture assertion itself.

PostWait completion admission fails only when the captured window context is canceled or the application closes. Both end the relevant UI lifetime; no surviving Capture button remains disabled. A full live mailbox waits for credit, covered by the deterministic production save-flow regression.

native_failure_follow_up: The strengthened native run exposed a real backend registry race and a fixture assumption that raw native.Close automatically unregisters the domain window. Reproducible patch25 synchronizes registry snapshots/promotion and avoids native callouts under its mutex; the fixture explicitly performs subsequent domain cleanup. Both failures remain in acceptance evidence.
